sisi.depan: A towering skyscraper with a multi-tiered joglo-style roof has a long, faded blue snowflake banner hanging from its spire and a fractured monorail track ending abruptly before it.
sisi.kanan: A smaller ruined tower is connected by a collapsed skybridge, a section of curved monorail track disappears behind snowdrifts, and the frozen facade of a market hall features shattered geometric screens.
sisi.belakang: The base of a massive, frost-covered pillar from a destroyed building stands at the edge of a vast, empty plaza buried under deep snow.
sisi.kiri: The snow-filled shell of a wide pavilion with a caved-in roof sits near a distant, leaning tower draped in another tattered blue banner and an overturned, ice-encrusted transport pod.

tengah: A series of toppled stone pillars half-buried in snow and a shattered, crystalline canopy from a walkway lie scattered across the foreground.
atas: A perpetually overcast, dark grey sky from which a constant, light snow falls.
